middleName.description: Saved middle name; null when unset.

FunctionOutput_freshteam_updateemployee.description: The employee identity returned after the update.

tags.instructions: Get employeeId from `list-employees` or `get-employee`. Only supplied non-null fields are changed; omission and null retain existing values. roleIds replaces the role set, not adds to it. Use `send-employee-portal-invitation` to send an invitation separately. Requires HR Partner, Admin, or Account Admin authority.

functions.name: update-new-hire
functions.description: Partially modify a new hire's contact, employment, organizational, or onboarding information. Omitted fields and null values retain their existing values.

newHireId.description: Freshteam identifier of the new hire to modify.

gender.description: Replacement gender supported by the API.

status.description: hired means in new hire queue, initiated means onboarding started, submitted means onboarding completed; null retains state.

address.description: Residential address component changes; omitted or null components retain existing values.

city.description: Residential city change; null retains it.

state.description: Residential region change; null retains it.

street.description: Residential street change; null retains it.

zipCode.description: Postal code change as text; null retains it.

countryCode.description: Freshteam country code change; null retains it.

branchId.description: Replacement branch identifier; null does not remove the assignment.

lastName.description: Replacement family name; null retains it.

firstName.description: Replacement business first name; null retains it.

middleName.description: Replacement middle name; null retains it.

joiningDate.description: Replacement joining calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

workNumbers.description: Complete replacement work-number list; [] requests an empty list and null retains the list.

name.description: Category of the replacement contact number.

number.description: Phone or extension as text, preserving leading zeros.

items.description: A replacement work contact number.

customFields.description: Custom field key changes. Omitted keys or null values retain existing values; non-null values replace the specified field value.

additionalProperties.description: Replacement custom field value; null retains the existing value.

hrInchargeId.description: Replacement HR manager's employee record identifier.

officialEmail.description: Replacement work email; null retains it.

personalEmail.description: Replacement personal email; null retains it.

reportingToId.description: Replacement reporting manager's employee record identifier.

communicationAddress.description: Communication address component changes; omitted or null components retain existing values.

zipCode.description: Communication postal code change as text.

sameAsResidential.description: Whether the communication address matches the residence; null retains the current setting.

changes.description: Partial changes. Omitted or null fields retain existing values; empty values are explicit replacements, subject to provider validation.

FunctionInput_freshteam_updatenewhire.description: Identify one new hire and supply only the changes to apply.

id.description: Identifier of the modified new hire.

status.description: Onboarding state returned after modification, if present.

updatedAt.description: Record modification instant normalized to UTC Z, if returned.

FunctionOutput_freshteam_updatenewhire.description: Current identity and onboarding state of the modified new hire.

tags.instructions: Get the record and ID with `get-new-hire` first when needed. Supply only fields to change; null does not clear a field. Status changes can represent starting or completing onboarding. Nested address/custom-field changes preserve unspecified entries. Empty strings and arrays are explicit replacements where accepted by Freshteam. Use `create-new-hire` for a new person.

functions.name: update-time-off-request-approval
functions.description: Approve a known time-off request. Requires an HR Partner, Admin, Reporting Manager, or Account Admin connection user with authority over the request.

timeOffRequestId.description: Freshteam identifier of the request to approve.

FunctionInput_freshteam_updatetimeoffreq.description: Identifies the known time-off request to approve.

status.description: Confirmed request state returned by the approval operation.

leaveDays.description: Provider-calculated number of leave days, including fractional values.

updatedAt.description: Record modification instant in UTC Z form; not represented as a separate approval timestamp.

attachment.description: Attachment metadata returned by the operation, or null when there is no attachment.

url.description: Provider link from which the attachment may be retrieved.

fileName.description: Original document name, including file extension.

description.description: Applicant's note about the attached document.

sizeKilobytes.description: Provider's attachment-size text in kilobytes, retained exactly without guessing numeric formatting or byte conversion.

approvedById.description: Approving employee identifier if returned; null is preserved.

statusComments.description: Status note returned by Freshteam; no comment input is inferred.

FunctionOutput_freshteam_updatetimeoffre.description: Confirmed approval receipt with returned request state and attachment metadata.

tags.instructions: Obtain the request ID from `list-time-off-requests`, `get-time-off-request`, or creation. Review the request before approving it. This changes its state to approved; it does not delete it. There is no decline or undo-approval action in this tool. Check the current state before repeating an uncertain approval.
